description: Reads which colours the registration, thank-you and room pages really use right now: background, text, button fill and button text, and where they come from (the host's own confirmed brand colours, or the site). With `kind` set to logo or favicon it samples the host's own brand image on the server and returns the colours it finds, which is how the host gets a palette without typing hex codes. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it before changing a colour (that is wi_change_webinar_colors) and when the host asks why the pages do not look like their site. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

kind.description: Sample the host's brand instead of reading the stored colours: logo reads the site logo, favicon the site icon.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, to read the colours that really apply to it.

name: wi_get_webinar_colors
title: Read the colours of the webinar pages
